items.exampleEn: This road goes to the beach.
The price of gas went up again.
The tracks go over a long bridge.
items.exampleZh: 鐵軌經過一座長長的橋。

items.exampleEn: Take the express to save time.
I always sleep on long flights.
items.exampleZh: 我搭長途班機時總是在睡覺。

items.exampleEn: Follow the path along the river.
The train travels at a high speed.
The tour starts at nine in front of the hotel.
items.exampleZh: 導覽行程九點在飯店前面出發。

items.sentenceEn: The express train doesn't stop here.

items.audioEn: Our flight was late, so we missed the city tour.
items.audioZh: 我們的班機誤點了，所以錯過了市區觀光。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼錯過了市區觀光？

items.sentenceEn: There's a small path behind the house.
Please don't drive at that speed.

items.stemEn: The train to Taipei leaves from ____ three.
items.stemZh: 往台北的火車從第三月台出發。

items.stemEn: We need to stop and buy ____ for the car.
items.stemZh: 我們需要停下來幫車子加油。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, Kevin's family drove to the mountains. On the way, they stopped to buy gas. Later, the road became too small for the car, so they walked up a small path. At the top, they watched an express train go along the tracks far below. The next day, they took a short tour of a tea farm.
items.passageZh: 上週末，Kevin 一家人開車去山上。路上他們停下來加油。後來路變得太小，車子開不過去，他們就沿著一條小路走上去。在山頂，他們看著一班快車沿著遠遠下方的鐵軌駛過。隔天，他們參加了一趟茶園的短程導覽。

questions.questionZh: 路變小以後，他們做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 我們的班機誤點了兩個小時。
referenceEn: Our flight was two hours late.
Our flight was late by two hours.
rubricZh: 「誤點兩小時」可寫例如 was two hours late、had a two-hour delay、was delayed for two hours

items.instructionZh: 用 tour 造一個句子，說說你參加過或想參加的觀光行程。
referenceEn: I want to take a boat tour in Kaohsiung.
We went on a food tour at a night market.
rubricZh: tour 是名詞（例如 a bus tour、a food tour）
「參加行程」可寫例如 take a tour、go on a tour
